description: The proposal centers durable ADR Markdown files under a selected repository ADR/decisions docs folder.
The proposal centers ADR relationship graph JSONL colocated with the selected ADR docs.
A dedicated cartographer_adr tool should create, look up, relate, validate, and import ADRs both inside and outside full Cartographer workflows.
The generator writes Markdown records from a stable template.
Generated ADR Markdown records are committed under the selected ADR directory.
Generated ADR graph nodes and edges are committed under the selected ADR directory's _graph folder.
Implementation completion should offer or require ADR generation after deterministic validation passes.
ADR generation can summarize the accepted problem, scope, and evidence from proposal artifacts.
ADR generation can summarize phased plan decisions and accepted validation criteria.
ADR generation should require validation receipts or equivalent command evidence before writing accepted ADRs.
ADR graph JSONL validation can extend the JSONL artifact manager.
ADR graph validation can reuse relation and reference validation patterns.
Docs ADR Markdown should be retrievable through project index search and context queries.
ADR graph nodes and edges should be available to search/map helpers without broad raw-output dumps.
Expose cartographer_adr as a dedicated shaped tool; keep cartographer_jsonl as a low-level JSONL utility reused internally.
README should document the ADR feature once implemented and remove/replace current out-of-scope wording.
TypeScript JSONL tests should cover ADR node and edge schema.
Python graph validation tests should cover ADR relation semantics and stale-reference safeguards.
README and proposal skill should describe the same ADR handoff contract.
Validated feature completion can produce an ADR as a durable postcondition.
